Root with inplace=False returns the value, and root with inplace=True raises JsonPointerException.","actual":"As expected. 'r is doc' is True for inplace=True, and False with the original unchanged for inplace=False. Root with inplace=False returns [2], and the failed non-inplace set left doc == {'a': [1]}. Setting through '-' mid-path raises JsonPointerException. A trailing '-' appends.","actual":"to_last returns ([1], '-') and ([1], 9) (no bounds check, which is only a parent/step split), and (doc, None) for the root. The mid-path '-' set raises JsonPointerException. The trailing '-' append returns {'a': [1, []]}.","evidenceFile":"/Users
